modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cobbleevt: Client-side EV training HUD for Cobblemon: per-Pokémon EV goals, alerts when a stat is complete or over its goal, and the EVs gained after each battle.
cobbleevtracker.goal.toast.title: %s goal reached!
cobbleevtracker.over.toast.title: Over the %s goal
cobbleevtracker.over.chat: %s has %s %s EVs and the goal was %s. Extra EVs are wasted: an EV-reducing berry lowers them.
cobbleevtracker.complete.toast.title: Training complete!
cobbleevtracker.complete.toast.message: %s has reached all its EV goals
cobbleevtracker.rival.toast.title: Opponent: %s
cobbleevtracker.config.hud_mode.follow_s: Shows the Pokémon you select with the arrow keys in Cobblemon's party HUD.
cobbleevtracker.config.hud_mode.fixed.to: Always shows the Pokémon chosen on the right, even if you reorder your party.
cobbleevtracker.config.fixed_pokemon.too: The Pokémon for "Fixed" mode. Remembered even if you move it to another slot.
cobbleevtracker.config.only_with_goal.to: Hides the HUD when the Pokémon has no EV goal.
cobbleevtracker.config.notify_goal.toolt: Alert and sound when a stat reaches its goal and when the whole goal is complete.
cobbleevtracker.config.notify_over.toolt: Alert when a stat goes over its goal (extra EVs are wasted).
cobbleevtracker.config.gain_mode.tooltip: How to show the EVs gained by any Pokémon in your party (battles, vitamins, berries…).
cobbleevtracker.config.rival_yield.toolt: When a battle against a wild Pokémon starts, shows the EVs its species gives (the same data as the Pokédex).
cobbleevtracker.config.edit_hud.tooltip: Drag the HUD wherever you want and change its size with the mouse wheel.
cobbleevtracker.edit.title: Move and resize HUD
cobbleevtracker.edit.help: Drag to move · Wheel: size · Arrows: fine-tune (Shift = 10)
cobbleevtracker.recommend.reason.slow_at: slow but with high Special Attack
cobbleevtracker.config.template.recommen: Based on %2$s, the final evolution of %1$s: EVs are kept when evolving.
It has several possible evolutions: recommended for its current form.
A general rule based on its stats, not a competitive set.
cobbleevtracker.recommend.reason.fast_su: fast but with low attack: better as support
